core_mechanism_bullets: Haudenosaunee elm-bark longhouses extended 80 to 200 feet long by 20 feet wide with central hearths shared by matrilineal clans.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: The United States officially recognizes 574 sovereign American Indian and Alaska Native tribes with inherent self-governance rights.
core_mechanism_bullets: The United States officially recognizes 574 sovereign American Indian and Alaska Native tribes with inherent self-governance rights.
Major federal statutes include the Indian Citizenship Act of 1924, Reorganization Act of 1934, and Self-Determination Act of 1975.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Federally recognized tribes operate on a government-to-government basis with the United States, maintaining their own tribal constitutions, courts, law enforcement, and natural resource conservation codes.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Review a map of contemporary federally recognized tribal lands in your state and demonstrate a traditional Indigenous game such as double-ball or hoop-and-pole.
